items.title: At the end it offers a draft MR description (F-27.2) and Browse and commit.
Available in self-review notes and author-mode threads. Never offered on a teammate's MR.
items.note: S-10 author-mode threads part waits for F-26.x (AuthorScreen is a stub); fix_allowed already covers own MR on its source branch; onFix not wired yet (F-25.2/F-25.3)
